scope: Static source/schema review only; no Cycle008 render or scientific qualification.

checks.mechanical_delta: Only Cycle008 stage/namespace/title/output identities; exact named inverse bytes equal the Cycle007 ancestor.
checks.region_delta: Only hard seven-state and index3/index6 assumptions replaced by actual saved count, complete zero-return path and dynamic actual peak/last checks.
checks.measurement_count_key: Actual measurement CLI declares declared_accepted_states; candidate checks this key and started/completed counts against the actual state count.
checks.legacy_role: Actual legacy metadata uses input_files_sha256[stage/result/result.json]; the corrected exact-role check is retained.
checks.legacy_csv: Actual declared accepted_numeric_states.csv SHA verified; index,leg,d_mm,clearance_bottom_mm,clearance_left_mm fields exist and match viewer use.
checks.chronology: All actual states, repeated levels and potential bisections retained in accepted order; original_target_index/leg/state SHA are checked. Dynamic peak/last are cross-bound to mechanical view metadata.
checks.path_scopes: Mechanical saved viewer allows clearly labeled partial results; region saved viewer requires successful complete zero-return result and complete valid measurements. This is intentional scope separation.
checks.geometry_vs_force: Mechanical arrows use saved N forces, signed force ON body and explicit mirror/scalar-sum meanings. Region arrows are cached face-to-edge ray witnesses, not forces; ray/unsigned/node-window quantities remain separate.
checks.display: Both use actual displacement at x1; mechanical x4 supplement has no force arrows. Region zoom changes viewport only, uses cached geometry, and retains the upper zoom summary anchor from corrected view003.
checks.null_semantics: No outward ray hit remains null/missing, never converted to zero distance.
checks.identity_and_output: Candidate input/archive/source SHA checks and exclusive new output directories are retained. No frozen formal source or media is changed.
checks.syntax: AST parse and compile(source) only succeeded for both candidates.

limitations: No actual Cycle008 image exists in this review; placement and legibility are assessed from source only and require inspection after rendering.
No geometry, force, tangent, pressure, contact, clamping or equilibrium qualification is granted.
